views.name: joined_zip_records
views.body_sql:
SELECT t.zipcode AS zip_code, t.boroname AS borough_name, i.Estimate_Median_income AS median_income, i.Estimate_Mean_income AS mean_income, t.tree_id AS tree_id
FROM trees t
JOIN income_trees i ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode
views.description: merges tree and income datasets on ZIP code to produce a wide relation containing both tree and income attributes

views.name: top_boroughs
views.body_sql: SELECT borough_name, COUNT(tree_id) AS total_trees, AVG(mean_income) AS average_mean_income FROM joined_zip_records GROUP BY borough_name
views.description: aggregates joined records by borough to compute total tree counts and average mean incomes, then applies ranking and limiting to return the top results
